description: This file defines the StaffingPlan document class and related validation and retrieval functions for managing staffing plans within an organizational hierarchy, including validation of dates, overlaps, and budget constraints, as well as functions to fetch staffing counts and active plans.

classes.name: SubsidiaryCompanyError
classes.description: Custom validation error for subsidiary company related issues

classes.name: ParentCompanyError
classes.description: Custom validation error for parent company related issues

classes.name: StaffingPlan
classes.description: Main document class for managing staffing plans, including validation and budget calculations

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method that calls specific validation routines

methods.name: validate_period
methods.description: Validates that the from_date is not after the to_date

methods.name: validate_details
methods.description: Validates each staffing detail for overlaps and hierarchy constraints

methods.name: set_total_estimated_budget
methods.description: Calculates total estimated budget based on staffing details

methods.name: set_number_of_positions
methods.description: Sets total number of positions for a staffing detail

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping staffing plans for the same designation

methods.name: validate_with_parent_plan
methods.description: Validates staffing plan against parent company's plan constraints

methods.name: validate_with_subsidiary_plans
methods.description: Validates staffing plan against subsidiary companies' plans
